Mapped against the real corpus, not assumed. The affected area is note-against-content, and it is covered by ONE documented flow plus two rendering paths. The flow: skills/folio-core/todo-review.md section 'Session Start: Todo Workflow' — offer, scope selection, then a TABLE grouped by chapter, then a flat list by priority. It is entirely list-shaped. The renderings: mountTodoBoard (a grid of stickies, mounted inside .fa-landing-board) and mountPageStickies (a badge beside each block heading, opening that block's list). No .bpmn covers it: the twenty diagrams mentioning note/sticky/todo do so incidentally (bean-lifecycle, review-task, content-change-review). So the as-is is documented in prose and in two client functions, and Phase 2 step 3 applies — document the as-is rather than pretend a diagram exists.
